a_procedure_review.verdict: Source-grounded and usable for controlled direct handler checks after the corrections below; no runtime result is claimed.
confirmed: The three existing T01 IDs, their controls, and member/admin modes match docs/stabilization/inventory.json. The proposals preserve access metadata and do not claim a new role result.

set_clipboard accepts {text:string}; get_clipboard accepts optional boolean trim and positive integer max_chars <= 1000000; clipboard accepts action=read|write and optional text. The proposed valid and invalid JSON inputs follow those schemas and the write-without-text runtime branch.

Tools > Catalog defaults to canonical surface; All handlers exposes internal set_clipboard and get_clipboard. The runner JSON-parses and Zod-validates, then invokes handler.run with permissionMode=act and assignedTabId=null. The assigned-tab helper then uses the focused tab.

The fixture uses one owned synthetic value on a disposable OS clipboard and never samples the previous clipboard. Chrome profile separation alone is insufficient. Clearing with set_clipboard {text:""} is a destructive cleanup of the disposable clipboard, not restoration.

The positive expected objects match the successful handler return paths. Actual Chrome clipboard success still depends on browser focus, permission, document context and the selected build; it is unverified.

required_corrections.issue: The get_clipboard optional-permission step says to wait until the extension reports clipboardRead unavailable. The Tools manual runner bypasses dispatch.ts optional-permission gate and calls handler.run directly, so that specific diagnostic is not assured. Its failure could instead be an in-page clipboard error or a thrown scripting error.
required_corrections.action: Before the get_clipboard positive run, verify clipboardRead state in Settings > Advanced agent capabilities and grant it there if absent, on the disposable test profile. Record whether it was already granted. Treat a manual-run failure as its exact observed error, without calling it dispatcher denial. Cite dispatch.ts:792-803 and ToolsView.tsx:453-462.

required_corrections.issue: Inventory T01 dimensions include permissions and reload for all three cases, but the proposed steps exercise only valid and invalid input, and conditional permission setup for get_clipboard. The precondition says reload an existing artifact, but there is no explicit post-reload result to record.
required_corrections.action: Add a non-invasive reload observation for each case: reload the existing identified development extension, reopen Tools > Catalog, locate the exact handler under All handlers, and record visible availability and schema before execution. For permission dimensions, record declared/granted state and any exact run error; do not claim denial behavior from the direct runner. If permission or reload cannot be tested safely, mark that dimension unverified with the reason.

required_corrections.issue: The procedures say focus a public HTTPS page but do not explicitly verify it remains the focused target immediately before each Run. Manual context resolves active current-window tab at execution time, and a sidepanel/Settings interaction may change focus.
required_corrections.action: Immediately before every positive read or write, confirm the intended ordinary HTTPS tab is selected in the test Chrome window; record only its owned test URL and no page content. If target or focus is uncertain, stop before Run.

required_corrections.issue: The cleanup directions are spread across individual cases and do not say what to do if set_clipboard cleanup itself fails after a read/write branch. The shared safety rule correctly avoids inspecting the unknown prior value.
required_corrections.action: Use one final cleanup instruction for the disposable OS context: attempt set_clipboard {text:""}, capture its exact result, and if it fails leave that OS context out of use until its clipboard can be cleared through an owned local action. Do not claim a prior value was restored.

case_specific_notes.EXT-F-4059-T01: The positive {text:synthetic} and invalid {text:42} inputs are correct. Its success only proves the direct handler wrote in the selected test context.
case_specific_notes.EXT-F-4144-T01: The expected byte_length is 32 for MATRIX_CLIPBOARD_TEST_20261007_A (ASCII); make the number explicit. trim=false and max_chars=100000 are valid; invalid trim string and max_chars=0 fail Zod before the handler. This handler uses MAIN-world read and declares clipboardRead optional permission.
case_specific_notes.EXT-F-4155-T01: The write delegates to set_clipboard; read uses its own injected navigator.clipboard.readText. It does not declare required_optional_permissions. Record exact read failure if any; do not infer that granting clipboardRead proves this route. tierFor reports read for action=read and action for action=write, but the manual runner bypasses tier-based approval.

b_quality_verdict.verdict: Revise, then suitable as proposed manual procedure text; not a completed test or role/permission verdict.
strengths: Narrow scope is exactly the three existing T01 cases and existing controls.
Exact valid and invalid JSON plus expected handler result shapes make the procedures repeatable.
Disposable OS clipboard fixture and synthetic-only read expectation avoid capturing unrelated clipboard data.
The runner limitation correctly excludes dispatcher approval, Ask/Act denial, role authorization, and live binding claims.
b_quality_verdict.remaining_evidence: No browser execution, build receipt, OS fixture, Chrome permission state, reload observation, or member/admin run was observed in this peer review. Keep both roles and runtime marked unverified until recorded evidence exists.
